import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTwistGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTriviality
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveCoordinateNonvanishing
import AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.ProperNotAffine

/-!
# Nontriviality of the projective twist on a proper curve

The projective coordinates retain their identity under pullback. This lets a
coordinate which generates at one point be used to test whether a projective
embedding lies in a single affine chart.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme.Modules

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem isIso_restrict_pullback_unit_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {M : Y.Modules}
    (s : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M) (W : Y.Opens)
    [IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)] :
    IsIso ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
      ((pullbackUnitIso f).inv ≫ (pullback f).map s)) := by
  let V : X.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ W
  let g : V.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme := f.resLE W V le_rfl
  let e : pullback f ⋙ restrictFunctor V.ι ≅ restrictFunctor W.ι ⋙ pullback g :=
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback f) (restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι) ≪≫
      pullbackComp V.ι f ≪≫
      pullbackCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f (show V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W from le_rfl)).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp g W.ι).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).symm (pullback g)
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map ((pullback f).map s)) :=
    (NatIso.isIso_map_iff e s).mpr (by
      change IsIso ((pullback g).map ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s))
      infer_instance)
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  infer_instance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem isIso_restrict_opensRange_of_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{0}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {M N : X.Modules} (s : M ⟶ N) [IsIso ((pullback j).map s)] :
    IsIso ((restrictFunctor j.opensRange.ι).map s) := by
  let e : restrictFunctor j.opensRange.ι ≅
      pullback j ⋙ pullback j.isoOpensRange.inv :=
    restrictFunctorIsoPullback j.opensRange.ι ≪≫
      (pullbackCongr j.isoOpensRange_inv_comp).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp j.isoOpensRange.inv j).symm
  apply (NatIso.isIso_map_iff e s).mpr
  change IsIso ((pullback j.isoOpensRange.inv).map ((pullback j).map s))
  infer_instance

end Scheme.Modules

namespace ProjTwist

/-- At every point, one of the pulled-back projective coordinates generates
on the inverse image of its own standard chart. -/
theorem exists_coordinate_isIso_restrict_pullback
    {n : Type} {X : Scheme.{0}} (f : X ⟶ (glueData n).glued) (x : X) :
    ∃ i : n, x ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange ∧
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange).ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso f).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (coordinateHomGlued n i))) := by
  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := (glueData n).ι_jointly_surjective (f x)
  haveI := isIso_pullback_coordinateHomGlued n i
  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isIso_restrict_opensRange_of_pullback
    ((glueData n).ι i) (coordinateHomGlued n i)
  exact ⟨i, ⟨z, hz⟩,
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_restrict_pullback_unit_hom f (coordinateHomGlued n i) _⟩

/-- If the pulled-back twist is trivial and global functions form a field,
one of the actual projective coordinate maps is invertible everywhere. -/
theorem exists_coordinate_isIso_pullback_of_trivial
    {n : Type} {X : Scheme.{0}} [Nonempty X]
    (f : X ⟶ (glueData n).glued) (hX : IsField Γ(X, ⊤))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (serreTwistGlued n 1) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ i : n, IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (coordinateHomGlued n i)) := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hs⟩ := exists_coordinate_isIso_restrict_pullback f x
  letI := hs
  letI : Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange) := ⟨⟨x, hi⟩⟩
  have hglobal := Scheme.Modules.isIso_unit_hom_of_isIso_restrict hX e
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso f).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (coordinateHomGlued n i))
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange)
  exact ⟨i, (isIso_comp_left_iff (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso f).inv _).mp hglobal⟩

/-- An affine morphism whose image lies in one projective chart has affine
source. -/
theorem isAffine_of_range_subset_chart
    {n : Type} {X : Scheme.{0}} (f : X ⟶ (glueData n).glued) [IsAffineHom f]
    (i : n) (hf : Set.range f ⊆ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange) : IsAffine X := by
  have hpre : f ⁻¹ᵁ ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange = ⊤ := by
    ext x
    exact iff_of_true (hf ⟨x, rfl⟩) trivial
  have htop : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : X.Opens) := by
    rw [← hpre]
    exact (isAffineOpen_opensRange ((glueData n).ι i)).preimage f
  letI : IsAffine (⊤ : X.Opens).toScheme := htop
  exact IsAffine.of_isIso X.topIso.inv

end ProjTwist

namespace Scheme.Hom.IsProjectiveWith

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem exists_affineHom_glued_twist
    {X S : Scheme.{0}} [IsAffine S] {π : X ⟶ S} {L : X.Modules}
    (h : π.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    ∃ (n : Type) (f : X ⟶ (ProjTwist.glueData n).glued),
      IsAffineHom f ∧ Nonempty (L ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (ProjTwist.serreTwistGlued n 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, _, i, hi, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  letI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
  let j := ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S
  let g := inv (ProjTwist.basicOpenCover n).fromGlued
  let f := i ≫ (j ≫ g)
  haveI : IsAffineHom j :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _
      (inferInstance : IsAffineHom (terminal.from S))
  haveI : IsAffineHom g := inferInstanceAs
    (IsAffineHom (inv (ProjTwist.basicOpenCover n).fromGlued))
  refine ⟨n, f, inferInstanceAs (IsAffineHom (i ≫ (j ≫ g))), ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact e ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j g).app (ProjTwist.serreTwistGlued n 1)) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp i (j ≫ g)).app (ProjTwist.serreTwistGlued n 1)

/-- A projective morphism carrying a trivial bundle has affine source when
the base is affine and global functions on the source form a field. -/
theorem isAffine_of_iso_unit
    {X S : Scheme.{0}} [IsAffine S] [Nonempty X]
    {π : X ⟶ S} {L : X.Modules} (h : π.IsProjectiveWith L)
    (hX : IsField Γ(X, ⊤)) (e : L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :
    IsAffine X := by
  obtain ⟨n, f, hf, ⟨ef⟩⟩ := exists_affineHom_glued_twist h
  letI : IsAffineHom f := hf
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ProjTwist.exists_coordinate_isIso_pullback_of_trivial f hX
    (ef.symm ≪≫ e)
  letI := hi
  exact ProjTwist.isAffine_of_range_subset_chart f i
    (ProjTwist.range_subset_opensRange_of_isIso_pullback_coordinateHomGlued n f i)

/-- A projective twist on a smooth proper geometrically integral curve is
nontrivial. A trivial twist would place the projective embedding inside one
affine chart, contradicting the non-affineness of a proper curve. -/
theorem not_nonempty_iso_unit_of_curve
    {k : Type} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] {L : C.left.Modules}
    (h : C.hom.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    ¬ Nonempty (L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf) := by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  exact not_isAffine_of_smooth_proper_geometricallyIntegral_curve C
    (h.isAffine_of_iso_unit (Scheme.isField_globalSections C) e)

end Scheme.Hom.IsProjectiveWith

end AlgebraicGeometry
